name: Kikonai (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kikonai town emblem in white: an outlined hexagon with radiating spokes around a central ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kikonai, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 16 June 1942.

features.role: Kikonai town emblem — an outlined hexagon with radiating spokes around a central ring
